🔒 Unlock Academic Resources

Pay once to unlock Downloads and Uploads for your KICHS account.

UGX 1,000
Manual payment
1. Send UGX 1,000 to the KICHS admin mobile-money number: 0706123923.
2. Choose the network you used below.
3. Enter the number you paid from and the transaction ID/reference from your SMS.
4. Submit the payment for admin verification.

Your transaction ID is used by the admin to confirm that the UGX 1,000 was received.
